# Rendering instructions

Render only the 4 slides listed in manifest.json. Use a browser viewport of 1920 by 1080, set body margin to zero and wait for fonts to load before capturing each page. Save previews at full size and create 480 by 270 thumbnails from those previews. Use matching filenames across slides, previews and thumbnails. Verify that all English text fits within the canvas and that the V2 marker appears at the upper right.
